description: Every local file the server keeps, in one read-only look, with no Suunto call and no credentials: the journal, the plan, the catch-up marker (seen), the prediction ledger, the experiments and the approval queue (path, exists, status, version, size in bytes, mode, counts of what they hold), and the cache, archive and reports folders (path, size, counts). `status`: 'ok', 'missing' (nothing there yet), 'unreadable', 'damaged' (not valid JSON), 'foreign' (not a suunto-mcp file of that kind), 'newer-version' (written by a newer server: refused and left untouched) or 'in-memory' (demo mode). `modeWarning` says when a file is not 0600 (or a folder not 0700), so other users of the machine could read it. Nothing is modified, created or repaired. Output: { inMemory, files: [...], directories: [...], warnings, notes }. The counts come from reading each file's JSON without the strict check. Demo mode: the counts of the in-memory stores, no paths. Read-only.
name: get_data_overview
title: Get an overview of the local files the server keeps (read-only)
